text:
Alex Chen: Heads-up 2
c on canary we saw clients reconnecting after a proxy keepalive reset and the console shows duplicate active sessions for the same resume_id. This leads to double quota accounting for ~30s windows.
Maria Gonzalez: Ugh. repro steps?
Alex Chen: Start SSE, kill tcp keepalive on proxy (simulated with `iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -j DROP`), reconnect from client -> server accepts resume on another shard, both shards mark session active.
Li Wei: Any logs?
Alex Chen: Pasted snippet from edge logs:
INFO 2026-03-20T12:05:41Z resume accepted shard=eu-west-1 resume_id=ri_abc123 last_event_id=42 client_ip=10.2.1.5
INFO 2026-03-20T12:05:41Z session-active shard=eu-west-2 resume_id=ri_abc123 last_event_id=42 client_ip=10.2.1.5
Maria Gonzalez: So two shards concurrently think they own the resume. That explains duplicate quota increments. Is there a lease/claim TTL we use to prevent this?
Dmitri Petrov: There is supposed to be a small lease epoch bound to the resume token (default 15s). If shard A didn't release properly on finalizers, shard B can accept. Sounds like a race on proxy half-close where finalizer isn't observed.
Sophia Patel: Console UX: we show per-route active_sessions and per-tenant cost. If two shards report same resume_id, we currently double-count. We need a dedupe in the console aggregation layer or fix source. Which approach do we prefer?
Maria Gonzalez: Prefer fix at routing/claim layer, but add quick mitigation in console to avoid alarming SREs. The dedupe should be by (tenant_id, resume_id) within a 60s window.
Li Wei: For routing fix, we can push an atomic claim in central metadata (consistent store) when accepting resume. But that adds a roundtrip to accept path and may hurt latency. Alternative: use last_event_id monotonic check + short lease handshake.
Dmitri Petrov: Proposed compromise: optimistic accept, then background confirm via async claim RPC to router-metadata; if conflict, reject duplicate session and emit a reconciled metric that console can consume to decrement.
Alex Chen: We also need telemetry: add a metric `resume_claim_conflict` with tags shard=? and tenant=?. That will let us track how frequent these races are.
Sophia Patel: For UX, I'll add a console flag that treats duplicate resume_id within 60s as a single active session for billing display (non-destructive). Add an annotation on the tenant page showing reconciliation pending.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: routing-metadata patch (opt-confirm) -> canary in eu-west next 30m.
Maria Gonzalez: Can we also add a debug-level log with `claim_nonce` so we can correlate which accept path won?
Dmitri Petrov: Yes. Claim nonce + shard id + monotonic counter. Will send PR.
Li Wei: For the short-term, ops-bot: can we patch the console to dedupe in aggregation?
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-8921: "console: dedupe active sessions by (tenant,resume_id) 60s window" assigned to Sophia. ETA 3d.
Alex Chen: Thanks. Follow-ups: 1) PR for async confirm (Dmitri) 2) metric + nonce logs (Dmitri/Maria) 3) console dedupe flag (Sophia) 4) canary watch for resume_claim_conflict spikes (Li).
Maria Gonzalez: Also check quota accounting path  make sure the billing pipeline consumes reconciled events to correct charges if needed.
Sophia Patel: I'll add a console note to freeze billing alerts until reconciliation is applied.
Alex Chen: OK sounds good. Will monitor canary and post updates here. :thumbsup:
